title: Letting a simple flavour please you

captions.energy: Following an unclear ideal of leisure
captions.emotions: Feeling fullness in the available moment

meaning: A concrete enjoyable activity supports your pleasure when vague expectations do not make you doubt its value beforehand.
text: Sometimes something pleasant is already available while expectation pictures an entirely different evening. The Empress in the physical position of Svadhisthana describes making pleasure from simple things: arranging a lovely plate, choosing music and making a place comfortable. The Moon in energy leans towards following a vague image against which today’s leisure seems insufficient. The Empress in emotions allows fullness to be felt in what is actually happening. Her repeated appearance distinguishes preparation from experience: hands create the pleasure, while satisfaction comes through meeting what you made, alongside the imagined ideal.

Suppose you prepare a plate of seasonal fruit together. You choose pieces, discuss a surprising flavour and change the music. **A small shared pleasure need not resemble an imagined celebration.** Warm light and conversation already give the evening a pleasing form. You can notice enjoying yourselves now, even with an ordinary courtyard outside and a simple table that matches none of the earlier pictures in your minds.

The difficulty is continually comparing living enjoyment with an unclear expectation. You add details without being able to explain what remains missing. The other person must guess, and what you prepared soon loses flavour. Available fullness is obscured by the promise of another evening. Recognising one specific moment you liked loosens expectation’s control and leaves both of you free to enjoy what already exists.
